5/5 Stars – Exceptional Service from SPC Construction & Roofing
SPC Construction & Roofing, led by the outstanding project manager Stan Hare, delivered an exceptional re-roofing experience for my home, and I wholeheartedly give them a 5/5-star rating. Using Decra metal shingles installed over my existing (slightly) hail-damaged roof, SPC provided a solution that not only addressed the damage but also significantly improved insulation. Despite some roofing specialists questioning this approach, the result has been transformative—my attic stays cooler in summer and my home warmer in winter, proving the value of this innovative method. Stan’s leadership was pivotal to the project’s success. He went above and beyond, coordinating additional tasks and offering creative solutions to complex challenges. Key highlights include:
Flawless Execution: SPC delivered on schedule, within budget, and precisely to the agreed scope, with no surprises.
Innovative Problem-Solving: Stan facilitated the removal and reinstallation of my solar panels, preserving the mounting feet and seamlessly integrating them with the new metal roof—a solution other contractors deemed impossible.
Aesthetic Expertise: Stan’s recommendation for an all-black roof unified my home’s appearance, reducing visual clutter and enhancing curb appeal.
Extraordinary Coordination: Beyond roofing, Stan managed the replacement of damaged front screens and a gas grill, ensuring every detail was handled with care.

SPC’s commitment to “getting to yes” and Stan’s proactive, customer-focused approach made this project a resounding success. Their professionalism, reliability, and dedication to quality set them apart. I strongly endorse SPC Construction & Roofing for anyone seeking top-tier roofing services and a team that delivers beyond expectations.

Sadly my experience with SPC was not a positive one.  To give credit where it is due, the roof work was fine and I believe that I now have good quality shingles.  Early on communication was good and they were punctual with planned meetings.

Now for issues – first one seems minor, but they did not do a great job capturing nails after the roof replacement. While they did spread tarps to capture the nails/debris, they were shredded (likely) from prior jobs.  I ended up picking up nail myself (filling a small coffee can) and ended up with two flat tires within weeks of the job.  Naturally the nails (in my tires) could have come from anywhere, but worth mentioning given the timing.

My primary issue arose when closing out the finances.  They verbally admitted to me that they made billing errors when invoicing my insurance company and they (SPC) had written off any subsequent insurance payments as non collectible.  Rather than partnering with me to resolve things with my insurance company (which I would have gladly done), my salesman became confrontational and expected me to pay the delta that his mistake seemingly caused.  Ultimately I had to do his job and resolve things by running interference between the SPC owner and my insurance company.  This may seem trivial, but equated to months of frustrating back and forth.

In the end, everything worked out, but my SPC rep really dropped the ball with my project.  I was torn between 2 and 3 stars, but elected to go with 3 based on the owners willingness to step in to work towards a resolution and small courtesies extended thru this process.

5 stars for SPC Construction & Roofing

I received cosmetic/marring damage from the 2024 Memorial Day hail storm to my DECRA stone-coated steel roof. A representative from a roofing company (not SPC) knocked on my door and was convinced I had damage and that insurance would provide a new roof.  After dragging my feet for a while and being skeptical of companies that show up at your doorstep to solicit services, I finally decided to contact a few companies in the area for free estimates.

I had three businesses come by and inspect the roof. Two of the three agreed with the initial company that my roof would qualify for a new roof.  Any of the three that suggested a new roof, including the one that initially solicited service, probably would have done a fine job, but I went with SPC. Each company suggested a different brand of metal roof with their own pros/cons, which made the process of choosing one a little more difficult. At least for me, I don't feel qualified to understand these differences. However, they did each say that they would install whatever brand we wanted. Ultimately, SPC had suggested DECRA, which again is what we already had, and it had performed well for 22 years, so we went with them.  Further, Jonathan, the owner, and his team were very pleasant in their pitch, including committing to helping with issues that went beyond the storm damage. We've had issues with rodents and squirrels in the attic, and they promised to ensure the roof would no longer be a source of entry.

Throughout the process, Jonathan worked closely and directly with the insurance company to ensure they covered all damage. He took care of all of this.  When the time came to perform the work, the guys were great. They removed my existing metal roof and underlying wood shakes and installed new roof decking in one day.  It took about 4-5 more days to install the new metal roof, and the gutters followed a few days later.  During this time, they did address areas of the fascia that needed repair and replaced an area of siding that had damage - all beyond the scope of the insurance claim.  Chris, the project manager, and Darren, and Jonathan would stop by often to check and monitor the status. I would even see Jonathan walking around picking up trash and debris, actively demonstrating his commitment to excellence and quality.

After it was done, I was present when the city inspector came by. He stared at the roof for a while and was very impressed at the work.  Additionally, we contacted a wildlife removal company to get more advice and an estimate on how to resolve the attic rodent problem. The representative was also impressed by the work, and had no roof-related recommendations that would prevent critter entry; the roof is sealed up.

I'm hopeful the roof continues to perform as good as it looks, but I'm confident SPC would return to address any issues that arise. I would highly recommend SPC Construction and Roofing and would gladly use them again.

reviews.text: We've lived in the Lewisville area for over 35 years and had several hail storm repair experiences. I can easily say that working with Zach and SPC has been our best experience to date. Their professionalism and quality of workmanship with this job will keep me as a customer. I would highly recommend you contact Zach King and his crew to make the best of a bad situation should you need roofing repairs in the future.
reviews.author: jerry b

reviews.text: I am thrilled with SPC Construction and Roofing. They were always there when they said they would be and did what they quoted. They explained everything that needed to be done and made sure I understood the process. Work was done quickly, workers were friendly and did and amazing job of clean up. Zack King the project manager was friendly, patient and always kept in contact with me to keep me informed of what and when things would be done.  On a scale of 1-5 I give him a 10.
reviews.author: Cathy Toby

reviews.text:
Our awesome experience began after a very rough spring weather in Northern Texas - many roofers come by after hail storms.  But when Don Jibben knocked on our door it was different.   An immediate connection due to his personality and knowledgeable answers to our questions.
He was there when our insurance adjuster came out and from that point on it was a smooth ride with SPC replacing our roof.  Professional team came and replaced roof in one and half days.... The crew was not only talented in their skills but they also did a fantastic clean up job at the end.
Hopefully we will not have to replace roof for another 12 years, but if God sends more hail to Northern Texas we will know who to reach out to.  Sincerely, a big thank you Donn.
reviews.author: Capra _MICAHelp Consultants

reviews.text: I had inside water ceiling  damage and after getting 2 prior quotes; chose Dennis Hudson at SPC Construction because his integrity and in-depth knowledge was impressive.  I knew nothing about roofs but his complete explanation of the entire process, product & warranty information gave me the peace of mind I needed to move forward and hire him to replace my roof.  His team started at the time stated, clean-up was cleaned up nice and Dennis sent me texts, pictures in real-time and updates with work needed outside the scope of the initial quote. I am very satisfied with my new roof and gutters....they all did an excellent job.  I highly recommend Dennis Hudson....he is a professional, extremely knowledgeble answered ALL my questions and  gave me an honest assessment of what I needed at a decent price.  Thanks alot...Great job guys!!
reviews.author: Margaret Deninger

reviews.text: We were extremely impressed with the level of professionalism and workmanship of SPC Construction and Roofing, and with Dennis Hudson.  We had a lot of questions.  From start to finish, everything was explained thoroughly and in detail.  Dennis kept in contact and communicated with us the type of work that would be done, when it would be done and the personnel we should expect at or in our home to do it.  A hail storm had damaged our roof with rain penetration inside our home also.  The roof work went very well, together with inside repairs to sheetrock and paint.  Looked seamless upon completion.  Dennis and the crew at SPC checked the attic before, during and after re-roofing the house for nail penetration.  Likewise, during and after they searched for and cleaned the yard for any nails or debris.  Gutters replaced, window screens as well.  We would highly recommend SPC and Dennis for anyone who has roofing or construction needs/concerns.
reviews.author: B Matheidas

reviews.text: Dennis, Mike, Craig are the best as are their crews.  They've done two replacements roof, doors, fencing for us after previous storms.  These days you'll BE hard pressed to find this level of quality and customer service in this region and from what I understand somewhat beyond.  Promise.
reviews.author: l

reviews.text: In a time when it is so difficult to get contractors to come out for smaller jobs, SPC saved us! We had some shingles shaking loose and they came out to inspect right away. Great group of guys. Ended up having some beers with them after!
reviews.author: A J

reviews.text: Recently had our roof replaced due to hail damage. Our SPC sales rep (Zach) sat down and explained the entire process.  SPC applied for all permits and reinspection from the town . Zach was a pleasure to work with and always returned any phone calls promptly.  If you need a roof, I would highly recommend SPC and ask for Zach!  You will not be disappointed.
reviews.author: Valerie Miller

reviews.text: Dennis, Chris and their crew did an outstanding roof removal and replacement job.  The job was planned well with all resources showing up early and working like a well oiled machine until the job was completed in the late afternoon.  Any small issues that popped up (not originally planned for) the SPC crew was prepared and handled them immediately.  Additionally, the crew did a phenomenal cleanup of my property after the job.  There wasn't a speck of dirt, nail or blade of grass out of place when they left (which is almost as important as the work itself to me.)  The next day Chris came out and swept the property for any stray metal or nails as good measure.  The level of efficiency this group displayed from beginning to end displayed to me that this company has its processes and planning down to a science.  If the opportunity presents itself I will not hesitate for a second to use SPC in the future.
reviews.author: Andrew Rousch

reviews.author: Anthony

reviews.text: We struggled with finding a good, qualified roofing contractor that specializes in metal roofing repair. We were referred to SPC by our roofing supplier and were super pleased with the results!  They were incredibly responsive, knowledgable, and great to work with. Would highly recommend checking them out for any roofing/gutter needs.
reviews.author: John Thibaudeau

reviews.text: Wait until the warranty work any time you put new roof you are happy but wait until you have a leak they blame everything else except poor workmanship.
reviews.author: Mehdi Bonakdar

reviews.text: Darren at SPC Construction & Roofing helped us fight our insurance company for 10 months to get a new roof due to hail damage.  We were ready to give up but he counseled us that even if the insurance company denied our claim, we could continue to appeal.  Once the insurance company agreed to pay, Darren helped us pick a new roof option, provided addresses in our neighborhood with the same roof option so we could see what it look like on a whole roof.  Once we were ready, the roof was installed within a week of making our final choice and all the work was completed in a day.  We can not say enough about the fantastic service we received from SPC.
reviews.author: Cheryl Lewis

reviews.text: I have known Stan for the past 10 yrs. He has completed a few hail storm, re- roofs for us. Recently, he installed two attic solar vents. Always, have peace of mind, knowing SPC will provide quality workmanship.
reviews.author: Shane H

reviews.text: I definitely recommend SPC Construction and Roofing!!! I contacted SPC after a hail storm and they sent out Ryan Hinojoza the same day for a FREE inspection!! Ryan was so helpful answering all my questions and putting my mind at ease when it came to dealing with my insurance company. They were quick and did a really great job on my roof!
reviews.author: Molly McGinley

reviews.text: I was very hesitant about what company to go with to get some work done but I was pleasantly surprised with SPC! Chris Plue was a big part of how smoothly everything went. Definitely recommending to my friends in the future!!!
reviews.author: Richard Dunn

reviews.text: Have used SPC for 2 different properties.  They know how to work with your insurance company to get the best result.  2 roofing jobs and will continue to recommend them to others.  Dennis is great.
reviews.author: Janet Neill

reviews.text: I used SPC as I was recommended by a friend who they did work for their house. Absolutely professionalism at it’s best. They set expectations and they were all met. Communication is big to me and I was always kept up to date which made the entire experience better. You get what you pay for and I sure got my moneys worth. Highly recommend. Will use again.
reviews.author: Tom Stein

reviews.text: SPC is the best roofing contractor in DFW!  They made getting our roof replaced extremely easy.  They handled everything with our Insurance company and left the yard clean of all debris and nails.  I can't recommend SPC enough!
reviews.author: Will Stokes

reviews.text: From start to finish the company was patient, responsive, kind and the whole crew was so respectful even during construction. I’m getting my roof, gutters and trim painted by them. My HOA was slow and difficult. They did not rush me to make choices and let me take my time to find the best colors for my house. Roof was completed in one day with a lot of precautions taken to protect my belongings. Moved all my furniture and planters away for protection then put back perfectly. The project manager even came back the next day double check everything and do even more cleaning to ensure my puppies were safe for any roofing nails.
reviews.author: London Howell

reviews.text: Super great job!  SPC showed up when they said they would, and their crew is the best I've seen on a roofing job.  It's the little things you notice: such as not slamming packs of shingles down on the roof; making sure each shingle lays in line; using care when they strip the old shingles off and control where they go; excellent work ethic; extreme clean up, even a blower to sweep the patio clean; no nails or scraps left behind; and the list could go on.  All I can say is I don't think you'll find a better company!
reviews.author: Phil Dunlop

reviews.text: We chose SPC Construction and Roofing to do work on our house based on stellar reviews. Damage was due to hail, rain and wind, and the project involved a new roof, staining the fence and painting ceilings. Stan the general manager was the most engaged overseer we have ever encountered. He checked out every aspect of the work two and three times a day, even one Sunday. His good relationship with the project managers and tradesmen made the workflow seamlessly. They protected our pool deck and landscaping. Our  new charcoal Decra tile roof, with Herringbone half round gutters to match the color of the cast stone, is a work of art! Roberto and his team stained the fence and painted ceilings with great attention to detail. Thank you Stan!
reviews.author: Randy Brooker

reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of working with Constantino (i.e., Tino) Sereno who works with Jonathan Shaw at SPC Construction & Roofing.  Tino and his team are exceptional interior painters, and I cannot express how thrilled I am with the results. From the moment we began our project, it was clear that Tino was committed to delivering the highest quality work. Their attention to detail was simply remarkable; every brushstroke was precise, and they meticulously ensured that every corner and edge was flawlessly finished. What truly set them apart, though, was their outstanding communication and thoroughness. They took the time to discuss color options, offered valuable insights, and kept me informed at every step of the process.  They were always transparent about the project timeline and any potential challenges, ensuring I felt informed and confident throughout the process.  Their dedication to perfection and their ability to transform my space is truly commendable.  They genuinely love what they do, and it radiates in the final product. I couldn't be happier with the outcome and highly recommend Tino to anyone seeking top-notch craftsmanship and professionalism.
reviews.author: Paul Duesterhoft

reviews.text: I was looking for an honest company to give a second opinion let me know if my roof needed to be replaced or repaired. They did a thorough inspection and told me a repair was all that was necessary. They were very quick to take a look and complete the repair for a fair price. I would definitely recommend!
reviews.author: Cristina Ortega

reviews.text: Chris, Zack and the team at SPC were just completely easy to work with.  They took care of the whole process and made this as simple as possible. Great quality work.
reviews.author: Robert Vincent Jr

reviews.text: Jonathan Shaw and his team were on time, professional, and did a GREAT job!
reviews.author: Nancy Jackson

reviews.text: Chris P made.the process smooth and easy for me after the bad storms. 10-10 would recommend. SPC treated us like family
reviews.author: Bruce Whitlock Jr

reviews.text: Great company. Home built in 1955. Had a leak in a bedroom under old solar panel. They Assessed roof, no replacement needed just a few flashings replaced/repaired and surrounding shingles needed to be replaced. very reasonably priced.  Highly recommend and will use again if needed.
reviews.author: Judi Debrick

reviews.text: Had a great experience with Chris and Zach King’s team at SPC. They did and delivered what they said in a timely manner. I’d recommend them to my friends and family!!
reviews.author: Joshua Hinojoza

reviews.text: I was thoroughly impressed with SPC's professionalism.    Zack did a great job educating me throughout the process, and they completed the job on time, as promised.   I will definitely do business with SPC again in the future.
reviews.author: Brandon Rhine

reviews.text: Ryan Hinojoza provided us with quick service when we needed our roof inspected recently. It is so important to have a local, reputable company to give fair estimates on any needed repairs or replacement after these spring storms that do so much damage to the DFW area. Contact Ryan for any roofing needs!
reviews.author: Team Hinojoza

reviews.text: Highly recommend! SPC was able to accommodate our need for a quick turnaround and stay in our budget! Zack, Colby, and their team were so professional and helpful!
reviews.author: Callie Johnson

reviews.text: Stan Hare was my contact on the storm damage repair. He followed up daily, all the contractors did an exceptional job. Any questions or concerns I had were immediately answered.
reviews.author: ginny elder

reviews.text: Very happy with the overall experience.   Replaced my roof and fixed gutters around my patio.  Friendly, knowledgeable, professional, and all for a fair price.   I would recommend without hesitation.
reviews.author: Chuck Rinks

reviews.text: Mr. Zach King treated me like I was his father- Without Zach my insurance company would not have paid for my roof- I could never Thank You enough Zack !!!
reviews.author: Mike Maltese

reviews.text: SPC is a Platinum Preferred Company and it shows through their professionalism in each project.  Everything is handled with care and executed seamlessly. I highly recommend SPC through and through!  Great Company!!
reviews.author: Jessica Neal

reviews.text: SPC replaced my roof damaged by tornado. They were extremely professional, timely, and responsive. Highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Jon Hutcheson

reviews.text: Dennis Hudson was awesome!  From quote to completion Dennis and his crew were very professional and got the job done competently and with no mess!   Can't say enough good things about Dennis!
reviews.author: Peggy Pohl

reviews.text: Easily the best service.  Most of the roofing companies around here come off as fly by night con men but SPC is true Service provider.  I would trust these guys with anything and I have for years!
reviews.author: Terry

reviews.text: Worked with Dennis and he was a straight shooter - he was honest with me and i felt like I could trust him and the company. They did great work
reviews.author: AK Kulkarni

reviews.text: SPC Construction, Zach King, checked our property after the storm.  He is prompt, efficient and a go getter!  Thumbs up!

reviews.author: Austin Zuniga

reviews.text: Stan did a wonderful job as well as his crew. I would highly recommend this company to my family and friends.!
reviews.author: Mark Gilbert

reviews.text: Best in the business!! I’ve worked with Chris Pleau and his team for years now and have always had an incredible experience. Highly recommend!!
reviews.author: Timothy Peterson

reviews.text: Always were responsive to our needs. Quality work and great follow up. We love our new roof.

reviews.text: Worked professionally with the owner of the company on a project and was very happy to be partners. If your looking to support a local business professional look these guys up!
